notes.title: Ver. 1.1.5
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9753216/a953e41b659f66227b2f789637923450d88b77f7.gif

Ver. 1.1.5
- Mini-game when Tsioque runs on stairs is now shorter. We've received a lot of suggestions and comments that this part of the game was too long. So we decided to record a shorter music track and thus this mini-game became shorter but at the same time it's more intense.
- few bugs and glitches fixed

Ohnoo Studio & Smile

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9753216/5344ec205fea3665e3e12db79e09628ee3949e9e.gif

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.4 / ArtBook / OST
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9753216/e3fb26b96df44d1d3cc4cf1075e8a344193ad70d.gif

Ver. 1.1.4
- bugs and glitches fixed

If you haven't noticed it yet, the Artbook and extended Soundtrack are available (note that both of these items are downloaded to the game directory).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/994950/TSIOQUE__Digital_Artbook
A carefully picked collection of hundreds of sketches, concept arts and illustrations, this 64-page Artbook is a journal of almost 6 years of TSIOQUE's development, from early concepts and animation roughs to final in-game and promotional art.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003410/TSIOQUE__Original_Soundtrack_OST
67 tracks from the game by Ed Harrison and Elle Kharitou. Mp3 & FLAC versions.

We also thank everyone who created new Tsioque fanarts. They are great and made with passion! Just have a look:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9753216/ccfa27f939ce385196b5abd4db9ff05fd08e7813.jpg

There are also many, many new and positive reviews!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9753216/b5f06603510b86656905de237a2202b9dad44902.jpg
